[RFCS.9.3a] The `Checkpoint` atom also carries the engine's cache: the
`Checkpoint.cache` repeated field ([RFCS.9.2]) holds one entry per live
cache key — `key`, `value_json` (the opaque stored value), and
`ttl_deadline_ns` (0 = no expiry). A reader that seeks to it
restores the cache from these entries before driving forward, so
`cached()` reads after the seek return exactly what they returned at
the original checkpoint ([LSTO.4.7]). Expired-by-`clock_ns` entries MAY
be omitted by the encoder. The snapshot is embedded in the `Checkpoint` body
(not re-emitted as separate atoms) because cache entries are not `.dstrace`
stream atoms in v1 ([RFCS.15.7]); the field is additive to `Checkpoint` and
needs no `StreamHeader` version bump.
